data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a mail draft with the same subject and body), and it correctly identifies country and client as the varying inputs. It goes wrong by ending with "Send the draft" when the true workflow says do not send and click Discard, which is a risky error. It also splits the client into a recipient_email and a recipient_name when the true email is {client}@example.com, and it doesn't mention switching between tabs. That makes the spec mostly automatable but flawed.
